mod.name: TB Vehicle Lock System
mod.summary: Lets players own vehicles, lock them and hand out keys to friends or groups. Other players can break in or short-circuit a vehicle with tools or by waiting, which can set off an alarm the owner can buy. Owners can also pack a vehicle away and unpack it later, except in blacklisted areas.
mod.notes: Install order: add the server and client PBOs, start the server once so the configs are generated, stop it, edit, then start again. Changes need a restart.

files.title: General settings and shop extensions
files.summary: Alarm durations and the purchasable vehicle extensions (alarm, packing, Discord alerts) with their prices.

alarmTimeInSeconds.label: Alarm duration
alarmTimeInSeconds.help: How long the alarm sounds after a raid or short circuit on a vehicle with an alarm.

stopAlarmTimeInSeconds.label: Time to switch the alarm off
stopAlarmTimeInSeconds.help: Time window raiders get to switch the alarm off again.

extensions[].id.help: Fixed identifier of the extension (ALARM_SYSTEM, PACK_VEHICLE, DISCORD_RAID_ALERT, DISCORD_SHORT_CIRCUIT_ALERT). Used by the mod internally.

extensions[].price.label: Base price
extensions[].price.help: What the extension costs for any vehicle without its own price entry below.

extensions[].currencyType.label: Currency
extensions[].currencyType.help: Name of the currency used to pay, as defined in the shared currency config. "default" uses the standard currency.

extensions[].requiresDiscordWebhook.label: Needs Discord webhook
extensions[].requiresDiscordWebhook.help: Set by the mod: 1 for the two Discord alert extensions, which need a webhook address. Do not change.

extensions[].vehicleTypPrices[].carType.label: Vehicle type
extensions[].vehicleTypPrices[].carType.help: Class name of the vehicle this price applies to. The shipped value ExampleCar is only a placeholder.

extensions[].vehicleTypPrices[].price.label: Price for this vehicle
extensions[].vehicleTypPrices[].price.help: Price used instead of the base price for this vehicle type.

extensions[].vehicleTypPrices[].currency.label: Currency for this vehicle
extensions[].vehicleTypPrices[].currency.help: Currency used for this vehicle-specific price.

extensions[].vehicleTypPrices.label: Price per vehicle type
extensions[].vehicleTypPrices.help: Optional prices that replace the base price for specific vehicles.

extensions[].disabledVehicleTypes.label: Vehicles that cannot buy it
extensions[].disabledVehicleTypes.help: Vehicle class names that may not buy this extension. Wildcards work: Example*, *CarType, *Car* or an exact name.

extensions.label: Extensions
extensions.help: The four purchasable vehicle extensions. Only prices, currencies and the excluded vehicle types are meant to be edited.

extensions[].disabledVehicleTypes[].label: Vehicle pattern
extensions[].disabledVehicleTypes[].help: A vehicle class name or a pattern with * at the start and/or end.

files.title: Pack vehicle
files.summary: Rules for packing a vehicle away and unpacking it again, including areas where unpacking is not allowed.

version.label: Config version
version.help: Managed by the mod itself. Leave it as it is.

canPackVehicle.label: Packing allowed
canPackVehicle.help: Switch the whole pack/unpack feature on or off. Players still need the pack extension.

vehicleCargoMustBeEmpty.label: Cargo must be empty
vehicleCargoMustBeEmpty.help: When on, the vehicle has to be emptied before it can be packed, so nothing gets lost inside.

handNeedsToBeEmpty.label: Hands must be empty
handNeedsToBeEmpty.help: When on, the player cannot hold an item while packing.

packTimeInSeconds.label: Packing time
packTimeInSeconds.help: How long packing a vehicle takes.

unpackTimeInSeconds.label: Unpacking time
unpackTimeInSeconds.help: How long unpacking a vehicle takes.

unpackBlacklistAreas[].name.label: Area name
unpackBlacklistAreas[].name.help: Free text name so you can recognise the area.

unpackBlacklistAreas[].position[].label: Coordinate
unpackBlacklistAreas[].position[].help: One of X, Y, Z (in that order). X and Z are the map position, Y is the height.

unpackBlacklistAreas[].position.label: Centre
unpackBlacklistAreas[].position.help: Centre of the area as X, Y, Z map coordinates.

unpackBlacklistAreas[].radius.label: Radius
unpackBlacklistAreas[].radius.help: Size of the area around the centre.

unpackBlacklistAreas.label: No-unpack areas
unpackBlacklistAreas.help: Circles on the map where vehicles cannot be unpacked, for example safe zones.

files.title: Vehicle raiding
files.summary: Whether vehicles can be broken into, how, and with which tools.

version.label: Config version
version.help: Managed by the mod itself. Leave it as it is.

vehiclesCanBeRaided.label: Vehicles can be raided
vehiclesCanBeRaided.help: Master switch. With 0 nobody can break into a locked vehicle, which is typical for PvE.

needToolForRaid.label: Tool required
needToolForRaid.help: When 1, a raid needs one of the tools listed below. When 0, players raid bare-handed by waiting for the time below and rolling the chance below.

carRaidTimeInSeconds.label: Raid time without a tool
carRaidTimeInSeconds.help: How long a bare-handed raid takes. Only used when no tool is required.

chanceToRaid.label: Chance without a tool
chanceToRaid.help: Chance in percent that a bare-handed raid succeeds. Only used when no tool is required.

carRaidTools[].toolType.label: Tool item
carRaidTools[].toolType.help: Class name of the item that works as the tool (for example Screwdriver or Lockpick). It has to be a real item that exists in the game.

carRaidTools[].quote.label: Success chance
carRaidTools[].quote.help: Chance in percent that an attempt with this tool succeeds. 100 means it always works.

carRaidTools[].damage.label: Tool wear
carRaidTools[].damage.help: How much health the tool loses per use, in percent of its health. 100 usually means it breaks after one use.

carRaidTools[].minHealth.label: Minimum tool health
carRaidTools[].minHealth.help: The tool stops working when its health is below this value (percent). The shipped files use 1.

carRaidTools[].timeInSeconds.label: Time with this tool
carRaidTools[].timeInSeconds.help: How long the action takes when this tool is used.

carRaidTools[].vehicleTypes.label: Allowed vehicle types
carRaidTools[].vehicleTypes.help: Vehicles this tool works on, as class names. Leave the list empty for all vehicles.

carRaidTools.label: Tools
carRaidTools.help: The list of tools that can be used. Needed when the tool requirement is switched on.

carRaidTools[].label: Tool entry
carRaidTools[].help: One tool that can be used to break into a vehicle. Add one entry per tool item; each has its own success chance, wear and duration.

carRaidTools[].vehicleTypes[].label: Vehicle type
carRaidTools[].vehicleTypes[].help: Class name of a vehicle this tool is allowed on.
